rows.en:
(Well, class is over.
Guess I'll head home soon.)

Itsuki Yamashiro
Mihoshi Academy teacher in charge of "Lectures"
Serious by nature; his talks can run a bit long...
rows.notes: Character card. Name given-name first per glossary. Zagaku class = "Lectures", as the schedule help (u5458 'Attend lectures'). Shared M/F.

rows.en: What is it, Yamashiro-sensei?

I noticed something while grading the last quiz.
You can handle the basic questions, but your
accuracy drops sharply on the applied ones.

And that, of course, is because you haven't
properly grasped the fundamentals...

(I know he's warning me for my own good, but
it looks like Yamashiro-sensei's talk is gonna
run long...)

Hehe, you haven't changed a bit,
Yamashiro-sensei...
rows.notes: Claire, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
But if you go on that long,
even \p-kun is going to
get sick of it.

Claire Stanford
A Mihoshi Academy graduate
A dependable upperclassman who looks after others
rows.notes: Character card; senpai as a common noun translated. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Huh? Isn't that Claire-senpai?
What brings you to Mihoshi?
Hehe, I just had a little business here.
Huh, is that right......
Claire-senpai!
rows.notes: Akimizu, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Yuu Akimizu
A classmate at Mihoshi Academy
Adores Claire, who's helped her out in many ways

Claire-senpai...
I'm sooo happy to see you after so long!

Funny, I'm pretty sure I saw you on our day off
last week, Yuu?
H-huh? Did you...?

Hey, you lot.
Crowding around here gets in the other
students' way.
rows.notes: Pinon, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Pinon Colette
A child prodigy who skipped ahead into Mihoshi
She also teaches the "Special Lectures" class
rows.notes: Character card. Tokushu zagaku = "Special Lectures" (built on 'Lectures'); not in the glossary. 'Mihoshi Academy' shortened to 'Mihoshi' (glossary alias) for width. Shared M/F.

rows.en: Honestly, you people...

Long time no see, Pinon-chan.
Hehe, still as tiny and cute as ever~

Hey! Don't call me tiny!
And call me Pinon-sensei!!

I know, right?
Pinon-chan's still as tiny and cute as ever!
rows.notes: Akimizu agreeing with Claire. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
I said call me S-e-n-s-e-i!
And stop saying I'm still tiny!!
I've grown a little too, you know!!!
rows.notes: Sensei spelled out syllable by syllable in the Japanese. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Sorry, but I'm bringing us back on topic.
As I was saying, you need to get a firm grip
on the basics...

\p, help me~!
It's Claire! Claire's got me~!!
rows.notes: Japanese is just 'Claire is--! Claire is~!!'; 'got me' made explicit (Claire is hugging her, next row). Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Ufufufu...
Hugging Pinon-chan still feels as amazing
as ever...
GYAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

(This doesn't look like it's wrapping up anytime
soon... Would it be okay if I just went home...?)

(Still, honestly...
Everyone around me is so lively and fun.)

(Well, class is over.
Maybe I'll head home soon.)

(I know he's warning me for my own good, but
it looks like Yamashiro-sensei's talk is gonna
run long...)

But if you go on that long,
even \p-chan is going to
get sick of it.

(Still, honestly...
Everyone around me is so lively and fun.)
(I came by S.M.S. since I was bored, but...)
Goddammit!
rows.notes: Ozma, before his name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Ozma Lee
Leader of S.M.S.'s Skull Squadron
Ranka's adoptive brother, with a huge sister complex

Captain Ozma's so on edge...
What on earth happened to him?
rows.notes: Spoken aloud (Bobby answers). Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
Seems Ranka-chan wants to go to
Sheryl's concert.
rows.notes: Bobby, before his name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Bobby Margot
Helmsman of the Macross Quarter
A man with the heart of a maiden

But it's Sheryl's concert, of all things!
Tickets are so hard to get, poor Ozma's
in a real pickle.
Ozma spoils Ranka rotten, as always.
rows.notes: Canaria, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Canaria Berstein
A pilot with S.M.S.
Works as a medic when not in combat
Well, that's nothing new.

Dammit! I can't even get Ranka
one lousy ticket...

Don't get so down, Captain Ozma.
I'm sure you'll get your hands on a ticket.
rows.notes: Shared M/F. Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
Come to think of it, I hear you're doing
stunts at Sheryl's concert.

Then getting one ticket should be a piece of
cake for you, right?

That's an order from your commander!
Get me a ticket to Sheryl's concert, no matter what!
rows.notes: Taichou meirei = an order from the squad leader. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
And if you can't get one...
you know what'll happen, right?
Y-yes sir!!
Good! I'm counting on you, then.

(Captain Ozma... I know it's for Ranka, but
he doesn't have to make it an order...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en: (I mean, this is just a flat-out threat...)
Sounds rough, \p.
rows.notes: Klan, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Klan Klang
Klan Klang, macronized to Zentradi size
Leader of S.M.S.'s Pixie Team
rows.notes: Character card. Zentradi-ka = macronized. Shared M/F.

rows.en: Ozma's doting on Ranka is a real headache too.
Tell me about it...

Heh, well, it's for Ranka's sake too.
Do your best to get her that ticket, boy.
I'll do the best I can...

(If I can't get that ticket,
Captain Ozma might actually kill me...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en: (Haah... I'd better give it my all...)

Captain Ozma's so on edge...
I wonder what on earth happened?
rows.notes: Female version of c24311. Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
(Captain Ozma...
I know it's for Ranka-chan, but
he doesn't have to make it an order...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
Heh, well, it's for Ranka's sake too.
Do your best to get her that ticket.

(If I can't get that ticket,
Captain Ozma might kill me...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.
